gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Gugi draws its stems and curves from one gauge of tubing, so the display letters look bold and cut open at the ends. Noto Sans Elbasan sits beside it with open terminals that never pinch shut.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Distinctive and bold, Gugi stands tall, its lowercase nearly touching the capitals and its line never thinning. Noto Sans Elymaic carries paragraphs smoothly, its open apertures and low ascenders never snagging the eye.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Every stroke in Gugi comes from one gauge, with no hairlines, and its tall lowercase nearly meets the capitals. Noto Sans Ethiopic meets it with a sturdy, modern sans lowercase.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-georgian: A constant-width line, like a marker, drives Gugi, and its lowercase rises almost to the capitals. Noto Sans Georgian keeps paragraphs moving with plain, open curves and short ascenders.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Bold in feel, Gugi has no hairlines to squint at, and its tall lowercase nearly meets the capitals. Noto Sans Glagolitic sits underneath with round, open letters that stay clear at small sizes.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Modern in feel, Noto Sans Gothic has lowercase counters as big as drilled glass beads. Gugi, meanwhile, is the one that turns heads, drawing stems and joins with no contrast at all.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Noto Sans Grantha is sans-serif, with tall little letters like pen-nib bowls pressed flat. Noto Sans Grantha reads smoothly under Gugi's true monoline headings, never snagging on a closed-up bowl.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Tall, tubular letters: Gugi's lowercase nearly reaches its capitals, and its curves match its stems exactly. Noto Sans Gujarati, sans-serif with large open counters, gives them somewhere to land.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-gondi: Contemporary in feel, Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi cuts its terminals back to leave big gaps. And Gugi, a bold display face, holds a constant stroke width that keeps the pair feeling steady.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Bold, stencil-cut strokes, all in one channel: that's Gugi. Shrink Gugi and that stencil-cut weight loses its punch; Noto Sans Gurmukhi, with tong-like terminals, belongs at the quieter end.
